SNOWFALLENMOD-ZHOU_FU.title: 织渊

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_BAD_LUCK.title: 好运

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_BECKON.title: 聆听

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_BURN.title: 燃锋

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_CLUMSY.title: 巧思

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_DOUBT.title: 决绝

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_GREED.title: 知足

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_GUILTY.title: 释然
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_GUILTY.descriptio: 净化时，失去3点生命，获得1点能量、1点月华并抽3张牌。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_INFECTION.title: 腐毒

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_NORMALITY.title: 卓绝

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_POOR_SLEEP.title: 安眠

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_REGRET.title: 筹谋

SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SHAME.title: 骄傲
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SHAME.description: 消耗时获得2层月之诅咒。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SLIMED.title: 织液
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SOOT.title: 活灰
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SOOT.description: 净化及每次抽到时，使手牌中随机1张无附魔攻击牌获得特兹卡塔拉的余烬；获得虚无。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SPORE_MIND.title: 孢子低语
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_SPORE_MIND.descri: 使所有敌人获得1层诅咒与2层中毒。手牌、抽牌堆、弃牌堆和消耗牌堆中每有1张孢子低语，诅咒层数+1、中毒层数+3。生成1张孢子低语到弃牌堆。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_TOXIC.title: 灵药
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_TOXIC.description: 回合结束时使随机敌人获得6层中毒；主动打出获得1层人工制品。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_VOID.title: 实相
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_VOID.description: 净化或抽到手牌后立刻获得2点能量和3点月华。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WITHER.title: 生机
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WOUND.title: 包扎
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WOUND.description: 净化时获得3层再生；之后每次抽到时获得2层再生。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WRITHE.title: 通达
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WRITHE.descriptio: 净化、翻回或从手牌消耗时，抽3张牌。
SNOWFALLENMOD-WU_YU_CHENG_XIAN.title: 我欲成仙
SNOWFALLENMOD-WU_YU_CHENG_XIAN.descripti: 获得{Energy:diff()}点能量，回复{Heal:diff()}点生命，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
SNOWFALLENMOD-DAY0_CURSE.title: DAY0的诅咒
SNOWFALLENMOD-DAY0_CURSE.description: 每回合开始时若在手牌中：失去{HpLoss:diff()}点生命，获得{WeakPower:diff()}层虚弱和{VulnerablePower:diff()}层易伤，失去{EnergyLoss:diff()}点能量。
SNOWFALLENMOD-WINTER_HIBERNATION.title: 冬蛰眠
SNOWFALLENMOD-WINTER_HIBERNATION.descrip: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。战斗中每累计失去{HpPerDamage:diff()}点生命，伤害增加1。
SNOWFALLENMOD-STONE_FLOURISH.title: 石蘩生
SNOWFALLENMOD-STONE_FLOURISH.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。将手牌中指定的1张牌变为朽木。
SNOWFALLENMOD-STONE_FLOURISH.selectionSc: 选择要变为朽木的手牌。
SNOWFALLENMOD-ROTTEN_WOOD.title: 朽木
SNOWFALLENMOD-ROTTEN_WOOD.description: 回合结束时，下回合开始时获得1层残朽。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WITHER.normalDesc: 回合结束时，回复3点生命。
SNOWFALLENMOD-PURIFIED_WITHER.rottenWood: 回合结束时，若在手牌中，回复5点生命。
